title: Harden chat and markdown security toggles before training rollout
description: Address high-risk audit findings by adding configurable controls and defaults for clipboard external fetch behavior, markdown sanitization coverage, mermaid hardening, and CSP baseline.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from high-confidence findings in audit #5; intended as precondition hardening before expanded local model training operations.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented Mermaid hardening controls: default-enabled with configurable disable and restriction modes (standard/restricted/strict), wired through admin settings and markdown render surfaces. Remaining work includes clipboard external-fetch policy and CSP baseline tightening.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented clipboard external image fetch policy toggle (`MemorySmith:Chat:ClipboardFetchExternalImagesEnabled`) so paste flow no longer fetches HTTP/HTTPS image URLs unless explicitly enabled. Added configurable CSP baseline settings (`MemorySmith:ContentSecurityPolicyEnabled`, `MemorySmith:ContentSecurityPolicy`) and response-header middleware plus API contract test coverage. Remaining scope is markdown sanitization coverage follow-up.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed markdown sanitization coverage and runtime hardening follow-up. Added trusted-mode coverage for single-quoted, unquoted, and `srcset` attribute sanitization paths in `ChatMarkdownRenderer`, including disallowed URI-scheme filtering. Added configurable security headers with defaults and request-pipeline coverage: `X-Content-Type-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `X-Frame-Options`, and `Permissions-Policy`, including explicit disabled-path integration tests.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Audit-family validation note: the original Audit #5 clipboard/CSP/markdown hardening claims are now verified resolved in live code. Evidence checked on 2026-05-29: `ClipboardFetchExternalImagesEnabled` is default-off and admin-exposed, `Program.cs` emits the configured CSP header, and `PagesAndChatTests.cs` covers markdown sanitization for markdown links, single-quoted raw HTML attributes, unquoted trusted-mode attributes, and `srcset`. The surviving follow-up from this audit stream is now diagnostics overexposure, tracked separately in `TSK-0213`.
